newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 30.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - Jan 30.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Former armed forces chief General Robert Guei sacked from army following inquiry into his role in alleged coup plot on eve of presidential elections in October 1995.
- Ivory Coast earned 100 billion CFA francs from sale of state enterprises between 1991 and 1996, Prime Minister Daniel Kablan Duncan says in speech on privatisation.
- Promising 1996/97 cotton campaign brings new hope for farmers in northern Ivory Coast.
- France and Ivory Coast sign accord on joint agriculture research
- Banned students movement gives warning of renewed strikes in continuing confrontation with authorities over jailing of three student leaders.
- Loteny Telecel to invest two billion CFA francs to expand its cellular network in Ivory Coast.
